name: mal-bazaar
description: Mal Bazaar helps users request and compare motor insurance quotes for their car in Egypt, review plan details, select a plan, and continue to payment or record a callback preference.

interface.longDescription: Mal Bazaar helps users request and compare motor insurance quotes for their car in Egypt, review plan details, select a plan, and continue to payment or record a callback preference.
capabilities: Request motor insurance quotes for a car in Egypt
Compare priced plans from Egyptian insurers
Review the selected plan and continue to payment on malbazaar.com
defaultPrompt: Get me car insurance quotes for a 2024 Toyota Corolla valued at 1,200,000 EGP in Egypt.
عايز أأمن عربيتي هيونداي إلنترا ٢٠٢٢ في مصر، قيمتها ٩٠٠ ألف جنيه.
I want to insure my Kia in Egypt.

positive.description: Request and compare motor insurance plans.
positive.prompt: Get me car insurance quotes for a 2024 Toyota Corolla valued at 1,200,000 EGP in Egypt.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the vehicle details, collects the remaining required information, and displays factual motor plan options and the selected summary.

positive.description: Request motor insurance quotes from a vehicle description in Arabic.
positive.prompt: عايز أأمن عربيتي هيونداي إلنترا ٢٠٢٢ في مصر، قيمتها ٩٠٠ ألف جنيه.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Arabic, resolves the make and model, collects the remaining required information, and displays the motor plan options and the selected summary.

positive.description: Compare motor insurance plans for an older, lower-value vehicle.
positive.prompt: Compare car insurance plans for my 2019 Hyundai Tucson, market value 650,000 EGP, registered in Cairo.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the make and model, collects the remaining required information, and displays the available motor plans and the selected summary without ranking insurers.

positive.description: Start a motor quote from a partial vehicle description that needs clarification.
positive.prompt: I want to insure my Kia in Egypt.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the motor flow, asks for the missing model, year and value before quoting, then displays the motor plans and the selected summary.

positive.description: Record a callback preference for an existing proposal.
positive.prompt: Record that I would prefer a callback tomorrow afternoon about my existing car insurance proposal.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the callback preference and clearly states that it has not yet been submitted to Mal Bazaar.

negative.description: Unrelated travel request: flight booking is outside the supported workflows, so the plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Cairo to Dubai next Friday.

negative.description: General automotive advice: choosing a car to buy is outside the supported workflows, so the plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Which family SUV should I buy in Egypt under 1,000,000 EGP?

negative.description: Unrelated personal finance question: budgeting advice is outside the supported workflows, so the plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: How should I split my monthly salary between savings and expenses?

review.commerce_description: No payment is taken inside ChatGPT. After selecting a plan, the user is directed to malbazaar.com to complete the motor insurance purchase.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: the plugin is now available in every country (no country restriction). Motor insurance quotes only. The MCP server is declared under the key mal-bazaar. No authentication.
